name: Heart rate (daily average)
rangeNote: There is no standard range for a whole day's average: it includes sleep, walking and exercise. It's most useful compared with your own past days. Usually from a watch or ring.
summary: Your average heart rate over a day, from a watch, ring or chest strap. It rises with activity, heat, stress, illness, alcohol and poor sleep, so a run of higher days can be an early sign that something is off.

high.meaning: Days with a higher average than usual often follow illness, alcohol, poor sleep, heat or stress. A persistently high or irregular heart rate with symptoms needs a doctor.

low.meaning: A lower average is common with good fitness or a restful day.

sources.title: Inter- and intraindividual variability in daily resting heart rate and its associations with age, sex, sleep, BMI, and time of year: Retrospective, longitudinal cohort study of 92,457 adults
